get.summary: Get a parsed Modrinth modpack version
get.description: Downloads the primary .mrpack, parses modrinth.index.json into the standard files array, and appends the source archive as type mr-extract. Resolved entries use the Modrinth project ID in id and version ID in version; unresolved or external files fall back to their SHA-1 identity. The sha1 field remains the integrity hash. A fallback SHA-1 may be passed to GET /public/mod/{id} for Modpacks.ch cross-provider lookup. Only entries with type mod are playable mods.

200.description: JSON object with status, id, name, type, parent, targets, specs, files, installs, plays, refreshed, and notification.
